summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $8,500,000 of ordinary shares under a September 18, 2026 Sales Agreement with BTIG, LLC as sales agent. Shares trade on NYSE American under NSRX; last reported sale price was $3.53 on September 17, 2026. BTIG receives up to 3% commission and sells on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with no escrow. Non-affiliate market value was approximately $26.9 million. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and selling pressure.
